notes: Element IDs were matched to pieces by the inventory page and the step pictures. Several Technic and modified pieces (b61-b70, b92, b94) were assigned by shape and may be swapped.

Many steps show pieces only from one angle, so the exact stud contacts are approximated. Examples are the rear slopes (b16-b18), the cab bricks (b43, b44), the pink trans plates (b12-b14) and the 1x4 plates (b25, b26, b39).
Steps 2-5 and 21 show the model upside down. The underside plates are modelled as joined to the chassis.

The roof (b47-b50, built in step 20) and the minifig are added in the final picture on page 33. The roof is joined to b43 only. The minifig stands on the 2x2 seat brick (b21). Minifig hard hat, head, torso and legs are joined in the order shown on page 2.
The pole base (b85) has a built-in pole. The traffic light (b86) slides onto the pole, and the pole extension (b90) goes on top. The lamp head (b91-b94) then sits on the extension.
No electronics are involved, so there are no electrical edges.
